instruction: How can I enable automatic screen rotation on my device? I want the display to rotate when I turn my tablet.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because automatic screen rotation requires hardware sensors (accelerometer/gyroscope) that are not present or accessible in the VM environment. The VM cannot detect device orientation changes, making this setting impossible to verify.
